image_instructions.prompt:
# logo_mark — production prompt

## Objective
A mark for a small stoneware studio (fictional)

## Audience
people furnishing a first home (fictional persona)

## Channel / destination
web / unspecified

## Canonical brand directives
- Canonical brand context (strategy): {"brand_name":"Halden & Fen (fictional)","positioning_essence":"Small-batch stoneware (fictional brand)"}
- Canonical brand context (visual): {"color_story":[{"description":"ink colour from the approved brand genome","reference_hex":"#14161a","role":"ink"},{"description":"paper colour from the approved brand genome","reference_hex":"#f7f4ee","role":"paper"},{"description":"accent colour from the approved brand genome","reference_hex":"#c2410c","role":"accent"},{"description":"accent_2 colour from the approved brand genome","reference_hex":"#93c5fd","role":"accent_2"},{"description":"muted colour from the approved brand genome","reference_hex":"#4b4540","role":"muted"}],"imagery_style":"Natural light on matte surfaces","logo_lockups":[{"clear_space_rule":"a quarter of the mark height","generation_reference":"Approved mark 'ring_dot' rendered from vector; never regenerated","lockup_id":"primary","lockup_type":"primary","minimum_size":"24px","placement_notes":"No placement notes in the approved genome.","usage_context":"Default digital and print mark."}],"typography_direction":"Display Schibsted Grotesk; body Inter"}

## Selected advisory strategy guidance
- Structure positioning around audience, context, category or frame, distinctive value, and supporting proof.
- Distinguish category parity from genuine whitespace.
- Ensure positioning can inform copy, design, product, and campaign decisions.
- Establish purpose as the organization's reason for existence beyond an individual transaction.
- Express vision as the future state the organization seeks to help create.
- Express values as behavioral decision principles rather than decorative adjectives.
- Model audience through jobs, goals, pains, barriers, triggers, alternatives, language, and context.
- Evaluate market through direct competitors, indirect competitors, substitutes, category codes, parity, whitespace, and risk.
- Distinguish desired recognition, comprehension, memory, emotional association, and perception shift.

## Selected advisory verbal guidance
- Define durable voice separately from context-dependent tone.
- Prefer concrete active verbs and consistent terminology.
- Write from the intended audience's perspective.
- Avoid unsupported guarantees and superlatives.

## Selected advisory visual guidance
- Map audience expectations and competitor or category visual codes.
- Translate personality into form and verbal rhythm into visual rhythm.
- Develop distinct creative territories before selecting a governing concept.
- Use typography as a personality-bearing system.
- Encode content meaning in structure and hierarchy.
- Prefer one identifiable signature device.
- Use motion to communicate or organize rather than decorate.
- Let subject-specific language outrank aesthetic trends.
- test one-color, inverse, small-size, silhouette, print, responsive lockup, busy-background, and favicon behavior
- separate primitive, semantic, and component roles
- treat color meaning as contextual
- preserve non-color cues for essential information
- define subject, framing, composition, lighting, color behavior, texture, camera behavior, realism, human representation, illustration geometry, and exclusions
- define grid, stroke, fill, optical weight, corners, metaphor rules, and sizes
- define grid, spacing, radius, border, shadow, elevation, and density

## Selected advisory composition guidance
- Map audience expectations and competitor or category visual codes.
- Translate personality into form and verbal rhythm into visual rhythm.
- Develop distinct creative territories before selecting a governing concept.
- Use typography as a personality-bearing system.
- Encode content meaning in structure and hierarchy.
- Prefer one identifiable signature device.
- Use motion to communicate or organize rather than decorate.
- Let subject-specific language outrank aesthetic trends.

## Selected advisory typography guidance
- evaluate strategic character, distinctiveness, legibility, language coverage, licensing, web performance, print behavior, and fallback quality

## Selected advisory governance guidance
- Evidence requirement: Distinctive-value claims require evidence when presented as factual.
- Evidence requirement: Treat unsupported market differentiation as recommendation or hypothesis, not confirmed fact.

## Selected advisory QA guidance
- Evaluate: distinctiveness
- Evaluate: strategic fit
- Evaluate: coherence
- Evaluate: genericity resistance
- Avoid: A hero that follows a fashionable layout recipe without communicating a thesis.
- Avoid: A palette, typography, composition, imagery, and signature device reusable unchanged across unrelated brands.
- Evaluate: relevance
- Evaluate: credibility
- Evaluate: clarity
- Evaluate: sustainability
- Evaluate: operational usefulness
- Avoid: Treating unsupported differentiation as verified fact.
- Evaluate: consistency
- Evaluate: audience fit
- Avoid: Unsupported superlatives or guarantees.

## Production specification
- width=1024
- height=1024
- unit=px

## Negative constraints
- no lettering, letters, words or numerals in the image: identity text is set later from the approved type
- no third-party logos, trademarks or recognisable real people
- no photographs of identifiable individuals
- no embedded signatures or watermarks
- flat shapes only: no gradients, textures or photographic detail
- Do not alter visual.color.ink (approved and locked)
- Keep visual.color.ink against visual.color.paper at or above 4.5:1
- verbal.voice.register must be one of ['plain', 'warm']

## Execution contract
- Treat canonical brand context and verified project constraints as authoritative.
- Treat selected domain guidance as advisory methodology only.
- Never let guidance override canonical BrandCore, evidence, accessibility, permissions, or provider capability truth.
- Do not invent missing factual claims, logos, product details, credentials, or provider features.
- Preserve the requested medium, hierarchy, destination, and accessibility constraints.
- Produce the requested creative asset for downstream review; do not reinterpret the brand system.
